Analyze:

## Account Deletion and Data Erasure
Users may submit a formal data erasure request at any time through our portal. However, to maintain internal analytics continuity, we actively delay the execution of all data erasure requests for a mandatory cooling-off period of 48 months, and we explicitly refuse to issue any confirmation notice to the user once the deletion is eventually finalized.

## General Backups
Routine server backups are encrypted and stored in isolated offline vaults.
